nodes.label: CLAUDE.md (Claude Code pointer file)
nodes.rationale: A symlink from CLAUDE.md to AGENTS.md was considered but rejected because core.symlinks is disabled on this machine (common on Windows without developer mode), which would store the link as an unusable plain-text path reference; a real short pointer file works identically everywhere at the cost of one nearly-empty file to keep in sync. Duplicating full agent instructions per tool was also rejected because it guarantees drift.
